what: A blurred (3px) leaf shadow is laid at 1.1x on one corner of the panel (default bottom right), and the shadow keeps tilting straight and returning over 12s, endlessly — soft type skew(3°,−2°)→(2°,3°)→(3°,−2°)→0, wide type skew(0,8°)→(6°,10°)→(8°,0). Leaf shade sways slowly in the wind over the white footer and menu panels

options.look: soft (default — small sway, the original’s big shadow on the right) · wide (big sway, the original’s small shadow on the left)
options.--fx-dur: (css variable) length of one loop, default 12s
options.--fx-w · --fx-ratio: (css variable) shadow width (relative to the panel) · ratio, default 59% · 8 / 5
options.--fx-top · --fx-right · --fx-bottom · --: (css variable) Shadow offset, default right −2% · down −5%
options.--fx-blur · --fx-opacity · --fx-shade: (css variables) blur (3px) · density (1) · shadow color (default ink 30%)
options.[data-fx-part=shade]: Leaf shadow artwork (SVG or image, follows --fx-shade when painted with currentColor) — direct child of the panel

use: Footer Content

from.where: shared.js .cm-tree (original ShadowTree — leaf shadow photo over the white footer · menu panel, blur 3px · scale 1.1, right 800×500 shadowAnimation2 · left 715×483 shadowAnimation1, both 12s linear infinite)
